ai_summary: Aastha Spintex Limited's subsidiary, Falcon Yarns, has secured GEDA registration for a 1.35 MW DC rooftop solar PV project intended for captive power consumption, signaling a move towards energy cost efficiency and sustainability. Physical execution is actively progressing, with 70% of Module Mounting Structure (MMS) marking and 40% of MMS installation complete as of September 16, 2026. This positive operational update highlights tangible project advancement, though full commercial benefits are contingent upon subsequent commissioning and regulatory approvals.
